title: Societal Condorcet winner
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with sign-valued output, and let $p$ be a profile assigning one of the six strict rankings of three candidates to each of $n$ voters. The society has a Condorcet winner at profile $p$ if the outcome produced by $f$ at $p$ has a Condorcet winner.
